children: United Steelworkers on Thursday said its Local 7-1 is urging BP
to return to the bargaining table, almost six months after the company locked hundreds of local workers out of their jobs at its 440,000-barrel-per-day Whiting refinery in Indiana.

"On Tuesday, the union notified the London company of its willingness to meet with a federal mediator as part of their negotiations," United Steelworkers said in a press release, adding that union leadership has asked BP to return to bargaining on September 14 and 15.
